test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.**

He said he was going for shopping and asked if he might get me anything.

options.text: He said, “I’m going for shopping. Can I get you anything?”
He said, “I’m going for shopping. May I get you anything?”
He said, “I will go for shopping. Do you want anything?”
He said, “I will be going for shopping. May I get you anything?”

solution:
The correct answer is: **He said, “I’m going for shopping. May I get you anything?”**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The reported speech begins with "**He said**".
 
• The verb "**was going**" changes to "**am going**" in the direct speech.
 
• The modal verb "**might**" changes to "**may**" in direct speech.
 
• The question form "**asked if**" changes to a statement and a question in the direct speech.
 
• The reported speech is enclosed in quotation marks.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1 uses "**can**" instead of "**may**", which is less polite.
 
• Option 3 changes "**asked if**" to "**do you want**", which alters the meaning of the question.
 
• Option 4 changes "**was going**" to "**will be going**", which is not necessary in the reported speech.
